profile.headline: Whatever the future may hold, I'm ready!
profile.summary:
I am a highly driven individual that views the world with a glass-half-full mentality. Knowledge is king and I strive every day to continue my education in the field of digital interactive development. 

Outside of working hard, I find it very important to play hard. I'm a huge disc golf fan along with anything associated to the outdoors; camping, fishing, backpacking, hunting, etc. If I'm not behind a monitor, odds are I'm outside enjoying some sort of social activity, hopefully soaking up the vitamin D.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rivermark has been a tremendous ride thus far! Starting as a front-end developer, I was quickly promoted and given an amazing opportunity to take the client-side gloves off to dig deeper in full stack development. 

As the code flies by, a quick reflection has prompted me to realize not only have I dug in for the long haul of server-side development but an amazing opportunity regarding deep understanding of application security.  This new found knowledge will only continue to fuel my needs and desires for future development objectives. With consistent challenges and amazing team support the sky is the limit as to what we'll dream up next!

positions.title: Co-founder / Ops Dev Geek
positions.description: Opportunist looking to conquer the world!  Well maybe not the physical world, but definitely the digital world.  As a co-founder of 2g Interactive, my hands are pretty much in it all.  From operations to development and everything in between. I love counting numbers, scoping work, working with killer contractors and at the heart of it all making awesome digital experiences come to life.  I specialize in front-end engineering which includes responsive HTML5, single-page sites and applications by leveraging a plethora of frameworks.  Do you have an awesome digital idea that needs to come to life, please don't hesitate to reach out!

positions.title: Interface Developer
positions.description: As an Interface Developer, I gain the exposure and privilege to work with a talented team of developers on a large scale international site, Nike Golf. My primary focus is to provide cutting edge front-end development solutions within a highly abstracted and agile environment.

positions.title: Interactive Developer
positions.description: Interactive projects are like drugs.  Once I start a project, the addiction for completion becomes irresistible. I especially thrive on highly immersive interactive projects.

positions.title: Interactive Developer
positions.description: Specialized in the development of Facebook Applications with a strong emphasis of object-oriented development in AS3.

positions.title: Flash Developer
positions.description: My primary focus was the development of fraboom.com. In addition, I built Flash games, client projects, and pushed for best practices in both UI, UX designs.

projects.title: Florastor Infographics (Responsive)
projects.description: Infographics are fun because they rely heavily on graphics to help explain a story, right! Telling this story on both mobile and desktop devices equates to a fantastic responsive experience. Please select a link on the project page to view any of the infographics associated to this project. The technologies utilized [ HTML5 | Backbone.js | Singularity | SASS ]

projects.title: NBC Virgin Galactic Space Tour
projects.description: Fantastic interactive educational project based on the Virgin Galactic Space Tour. This project provides a great insight as to what the Virgin Galactic spaceship undergoes from liftoff to space and back again. The technologies utilized [ HTML5 | Backbone.js | SASS ]
